about_the_game:
Throw your hat. Ride the wind. Hold on to what matters.

Hatastrophe is a story-rich 2D adventure platformer where your hat is more than just a tool; it’s your lifeline. Use it to float, climb, and cross impossible gaps in a journey shaped by emotion, memory, and change.

Features:

  • Hat-Based Platforming – Throw your hat to create mid-air platforms, ride wind currents, and hold on to it like a lifeline.

  • An Evolving World – Traverse hand-crafted environments that shift and transform as you progress, each reflecting a different emotional tone.

  • Illustrative Visual Style – Inspired by East Asian landscapes and folklore, brought to life through beautiful pixel art.

  • A Reflective Soundtrack – A tender, ambient score that moves with you through every step of the journey.

  • A Story of the Heart – Uncover the narrative through visual storytelling, flashbacks, and emotional beats.

Hold on when you need to. Let go when you're ready.
